lead.headline: Gordon is still benched and Diggs missed Wednesday
lead.deck: 2-5. Swap Gordon into the flex for Metcalf before Sunday, and make sure the Coker claim is in.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. At 13:05 UTC DK Metcalf is still in the flex and Ollie Gordon II is still on the bench. The projection prefers Gordon by 2.2, and nothing reported since Wednesday says otherwise — Gordon is Miami's starter with Achane on season-ending IR, and neither player is on a Wednesday report. Stefon Diggs did not practise Wednesday, listed with a hand, a hamstring and rest; Dan Quinn expects him back in full today. He is on the bench either way. Jalen Coker, dropped by mistake on Wednesday, practised fully and plays tonight for nobody; he is on Chem waivers until Wednesday 4 November at 02:00. This brief cannot see pending claims, so if Coker-for-Fairbairn is not in, put it in. AVIATO project 128.1 to Guillo-tinas' 88.7, 70%.

players.caption: Gordon — still on the bench; the flex by projection
